name: Agent Team
description: PFC PX-1 — 5 PFC-oriented subagent definitions (Explore / Plan / Research / Critic / Executor) contributed to the agent-definition registry. PFC-S2 adds a team-mailbox status pane to the Agents view as the first contributes.panes[] dogfood. PX-5 adds keyword routes so $explore / $plan / $research / $critic / $executor get suggested as Agent() target candidates.

config.text:
# Team Mailbox

Inter-agent messages land here when the plugin is active.

Layout: `.elanous/team-mailbox/<team>/<recipient>.mbox` (JSONL).

_Dynamic refresh via SendMessage → pane content: PX-8._

routes.description: Fast read-only codebase scout — grep/glob/read only.
Architecture planner — writes a phased implementation plan.
Code review / quality audit — finds risks + gaps.
Executes a pre-approved plan with Edit / Bash / RunShell.
